name: PsiQre
description: PsiQre is a Copenhagen-based post-quantum cybersecurity software startup providing automated cryptographic-asset discovery, risk assessment, and PQC migration governance for enterprise IT and OT environments. Incorporated as PsiQre ApS on 2025-10-14 by founder Arjun Das Kanderi (CVR 45956385), the company addresses the upcoming NIST PQC migration through compliance monitoring and policy-driven governance. PsiQre is a partner in the Danish Quantum Community and Quantum Denmark ecosystem.
